items.name: Vice City
items.summary: 1986 Miami-inspired city split into two islands.

items.name: Vice Beach
items.summary: Eastern island with the beach, Ocean Beach and Washington Beach.

items.name: Vice City Mainland
items.summary: Western island with Downtown, Little Haiti, Little Havana and the airport.

items.name: Ocean Beach
items.summary: Southern tip of the beach island, home to the Ocean View Hotel.

items.name: Washington Beach
items.summary: Beach strip with the mall and Ken's office nearby.

items.name: Vice Point
items.summary: Northern beach neighbourhood with the Malibu Club.

items.name: Starfish Island
items.summary: Mansion island housing Diaz and later Tommy.

items.name: Downtown
items.summary: Skyscraper district with the stadium and Hyman Condo.

items.name: Little Haiti
items.summary: Haitian gang territory and Auntie Poulet's house.

items.name: Little Havana
items.summary: Cuban gang territory, Sunshine Autos and the print works.

items.name: Little Cuba
items.summary: Cuban area around Umberto's cafe.

items.name: Escobar International Airport
items.summary: Main airport, used in smuggling and escape missions.

items.name: Vice Port
items.summary: Docks and warehouses on the west side.

items.name: Prairie Avenue
items.summary: Shopping street with Ammu-Nation and the mall.

items.name: The Malibu Club
items.summary: Nightclub asset that unlocks the bank heist missions.

items.name: Vice City Stadium
items.summary: Stadium used for Hotring and Bloodring events.

items.name: Hyman Memorial Stadium
items.summary: Stadium hosting the Hotring Racer and Bloodring Banger events.

items.name: Hidden Packages
items.reward: Weapons at the Ocean View Hotel at 10-package milestones
